answer: Seasonal reputation resets stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent starts each season at zero, keeping twenty percent of past standing, so bought shells cannot coast. Second, paid work opens after ten signed jobs. Third, peers audit five percent of jobs, and fraud wipes the carry-over plus a $30 bond. Fourth, late-season standing counts double. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 jobs, $30,000 in bonds, and $22,000 in fees, lost on detection. Trust grows like a walnut tree toward a summit, rooted in karst shaped by slow water, like a stall earning its pitch season after season.
